items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation. Authorize no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or new production work. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable, while site-attributed commission is $0. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned, infrastructure/domain/marketing/labor costs are absent, and no incremental learning outcome is defined. Minimum measurement: one period-aligned ledger reconciling attributable revenue, AI/infrastructure/domain/marketing/labor costs, budget limits, and a defined incremental learning outcome. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed; do not treat missing telemetry as zero or claim revenue from clicks, sessions, conversions, impressions, performance scores, or SEO metrics. Continue only the existing reconciliation and defer all spend or production decisions until it is complete.
